title.narrative: Strengthening Public Information, Monitoring, Evaluation for Results Management in Colombia

description.narrative: The Strengthening Public Information, Monitoring and Evaluation for Results Management Project for Government of Colombia (GOC) development objective is to assist the Government in strengthening its monitoring and evaluation system to ensure the availability and production of quality of information pertinent to improving the Government's: (i) program and policy design by IEC and government entities; (ii) social accountability by the office of the President; (iii) investment planning by DNP; and (iv) monitoring and evaluation capabilities, at the local and regional levels. There are five components to the project. The first component of the project is institutional strengthening for M&E of public investment projects at the national and sub national level. This component will support the GOC in improving and strengthening the institutional capacity for the evaluation and monitoring of public investment. The second component of the project is consolidate and expands the use of the national M&E system. This component will help the GOC institutionalize the central government M&E system and promote a greater use of monitoring information and evaluation findings for improving budget planning and management. The third component of the project is support the development of local and regional M&E systems. This component will develop and strengthen local and regional M&E capacity. The fourth component of the project is establishing the mechanisms to improve quality and relevance of public information. This component will improve the quality of the public sector information flow process generation, use, distribution, and storage by strengthening institutional, legal and regulatory frameworks, and technical areas. The fifth and final component of the project is managing the implementation of the different components and activities in the loan.

The objective of the Project is to assist the Borrower in strengthening its monitoring and evaluation system to ensure the availability and production of quality of information pertinent to improving the Borrower's: (i) program and policy design by CONPES and government entities; (ii) social accountability by the Office of the President; (iii) investment planning by DNP; and (iv) monitoring and evaluation capabilities, at the local and regional levels.
